'''Vader 1000 I've Tested The Carbon Chamber, Now What''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Vader 1000]]
* '''Published:''' 18 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / Cloud City Occupation|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 CCT Vader1000 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck uses the opponent’s cards as a way for you to triumph.  Also, it uses to most powerful characters, bounty hunters, to inflict massive damage and at the same time, retrieving and force draining the heck out of the opponent.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Basically try to flip the objective as quickly as possible so that you get the immunity to attrition but also make sure that you use the front of the objective to its fullest, getting the locations out, before you flip it.  Then, get Scum And Villainy so that you can retrieve anything that you lost before you flipped the objective.  Capture some rebels with bounty on their heads and then bring them to a prison or stop by the Interrogation room for a force drain bonus.  The only guys that you have to worry about with attrition are 4-LOM and IG-88 and hopefully, they will just capture the rebel pest that is making trouble.  This deck has never failed me before, but it hasn’t been used very frequently, any suggestions would be appreciated.  Email me at darthkling@yahoo.com!!
